batch.description: Jahangirnagar University A Unit (Mathematical & Physical Sciences), academic session 2017-2018, Set-3 — full 80-question paper transcribed by direct visual reading (with zoomed crops) of the Udvash 'জাবি প্রশ্নব্যাংক' (JU A & D Unit question bank), book PDF pp.81-84 (questions), with the printed answer table at the foot of p.84 and printed worked solutions on pp.85-86. EXTRACTION STAGE: all questions are marked content-UNVERIFIED and all keyed answers answer-UNVERIFIED — the printed publisher answer keys are preserved as-is and are NOT official JU keys; cross-source verification is a later stage. The book prints no per-subject headings in this paper (only a 'Short Syllabus' banner on p.81 and an 'Extra Syllabus' box on p.84); subject blocks follow the printed question-number ranges, confirmed by content: Bangla Q1-3, English Q4-6, General Knowledge Q7-14, Chemistry Q15-36, Higher Mathematics Q37-58, Physics Q59-80 — counts Bangla 3, English 3, General Knowledge 8, Chemistry 22, Higher Mathematics 22, Physics 22. Question numbers are NOT printed in numeric order across the pages: p.81 carries Q1-20; p.82 carries Q21-26, 29-32, 34-37, 39, 40, 42-47; p.83 carries Q48, 50-56, 59-69, 71-74, 77; p.84 carries Q78, 79, the 'Extra Syllabus' box questions Q27, 28, 33, 38, and (right column) Q41, 49, 57, 58, 70, 75, 76, 80. The answer table prints exactly FIVE dashes (no correct option) at Q46, Q54, Q66, Q77, Q80, and for each of them the printed worked solution (pp.85-86) explicitly states '(সঠিক উত্তর নেই)'; those five carry answerDisposition 'no_correct_option' with correctOptionIds [] and answerVerificationStatus 'verified' solely because the validator requires that status for a no_correct_option disposition — it records the book's own printed claim (table dash + printed solution), not cross-source verification — while their contentVerificationStatus remains 'unverified' like every other question in this extraction-stage pack. The remaining 75 questions are keyed single_choice; no dual keys occur in this paper. All 45 printed worked solutions (Short Syllabus pp.85-86: Q1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 18, 20, 26, 30, 32, 37, 39, 40, 42, 43, 44, 45, 46, 48, 50, 51, 52, 53, 54, 55, 56, 59, 60, 61, 62, 63, 65, 66, 67, 68, 69, 74, 77, 78; Extra Syllabus p.86: Q27, 28, 33, 38, 49, 80) agree with the answer table — there are NO table-vs-solution disagreements in this paper. Preserved print anomalies: Q19(i) prints 'পরমাণুর স্থিতি হ্রাস হয়' with no শক্তি after স্থিতি; Q45 options (a) and (d) both print 2/√3 identically; Q68's stem prints Young's modulus as Nm^2 with no minus sign; Q78's stem and option (a) print the dipole charge separation as 3 × 10^-19 m; Q75's stem calls both lenses উত্তল although one printed power is -3.5D; Q30(d) prints the couple in ion/metal order (Al^3+/Al) against the metal/ion order used elsewhere; Q49's and Q80's worked solutions are printed under the 'Extra Syllabus' heading on p.86 although their questions stand in the main run on p.84. No question in this paper carries a figure or diagram (figures appear only inside printed worked solutions on pp.85-86). [UNVERIFIED import-format edition: only the questions that did NOT pass cross-source verification, with true statuses preserved; see Admission-Unverified-Import/README.md.]

sourceDocuments.title: Udvash জাবি প্রশ্নব্যাংক (JU A & D Unit question bank)
sourceDocuments.notes: Publisher question-bank book (Udvash Academic & Admission Care), scanned PDF, 295 pp. Set-3 of JU A Unit 2017-2018 occupies book PDF pp.81-86 (printed book pp.80-85): questions pp.81-84, printed answer table ('উত্তরমালা') at the foot of p.84, printed worked solutions pp.85-86 (no solutions on the table page). Paper header (book PDF p.81) confirmed before transcription: জাবি ভর্তি পরীক্ষা ২০১৭-১৮ শিক্ষাবর্ষ, পূর্ণমান: ৮০, ইউনিট: A, সেট: 3, সময়: ৫৫ মিনিট. Transcription by direct visual reading of every page image, with zoomed re-reads (PIL crops at ~200%) for Q1's sandhi options, Q16-Q20, Q29-Q47 (including the Q37 matrix options and the duplicated Q45 options), Q50-Q58, Q64-Q77, Q78 and the p.84 right column and answer table. Mathematical notation linearised (^ for superscripts, a/b for fractions, √, π, matrices wrapped in [...] with rows separated by ';', unit vectors as î, ĵ, k̂ and vector arrows as →; chemical formulas written with plain digits for subscripts, e.g. Na2S2O3, H3PO4; isotope mass/atomic numbers written as left plain numbers, e.g. 14_6C).
